characters.name: Apocalypse
characters.errata:
Peerless added. 

HORSEMEN CARDS
War: Fury updated to once per Turn.
Death: Created to End reduced to 2 Power from 3.
Famine: No changes.
Pestilence: Consuming Blight increased to 3 Power from 2.
Master of the Horsemen: Gains 1 Evolution token during the
Cleanup Phase instead of the Power Phase. Can no longer
reroll attack and dodge rolls with Evolution Tokens.

attacks.name: BIOMORPHIC ARSENAL
text: Before choosing a target, this character chooses whether this attack's type is {PHYS}, {ENRG}, or {MYST}.
After this attack is resolved, this character gains {PWR} equal to the {DMG} dealt.

{WILD} Cower Before Me: After this attack is resolved, the target character gains either the Shock or Root special condition. If the target character already had the Shock and Root special conditions before this attack was chosen, Throw it Away {S}.

attacks.name: EN SABAH NUR'S JUDGMENT
text: Add 2 dice to this attack roll for each special condition the target character has.

superpowers.name: APOCALYPSE'S HORSEMEN (AFFILIATION: SERVANTS OF THE APOCALYPSE)
superpowers.text: When this Leadership is chosen, this character is assigned the Master of the Horsemen Card. Then you may assign the Death, Famine, Pestilence, and War Horsemen Cards to eligible Servants of the Apocalypse characters in your Squad. No character may be assigned more than one Horsemen Card.

superpowers.name: CELESTIAL TECHNOLOGY
superpowers.text: During the Power Phase, Choose up to two other allied characters within {RNG} 5 of this character. Each character drops all Objective tokens they are holding and is Placed within {RNG} 1 of this character.

superpowers.name: YOU WILL BE REMADE THROUGH ME
superpowers.text: When an enemy character within {RNG} 5 of this character would gain a special condition it already has, this character may use this superpower. characters.errata:
Peerless added.

Increase the power cost of the Power Cosmic Penance Stare attack to 8.

Replace the text of the Chains of Cyttorak superpower with the following text:
Choose a character within range 3 of this character and Push it Toward this character short. Then the chosen character gains the Incinerate special condition. This super power can be used only once per turn.

Replace the text of the I’m the Spirit of Vengeance, Bearer of the Power Cosmic, and Just a Bit Unstable superpower with the following text:
During the Cleanup Phase, remove all Psychosis tokens from this character. Then, this character rolls 5 dice. For each critical, wild, and hit results rolled, this character gains 1 power. Then, if this character has 5 or more power, this character gains a Psychosis token and drops all objective tokens it is holding.

Replace the text of the Ready to Roll superpower with the following text:
At the start of the first Power Phase and when this character would be Dazed, this character gains a Psychosis token. characters.name: Magneto
characters.packName: Magneto and Toad, CP140: Brotherhood of Mutants Affiliation Pack,CP271: X-Men Starter Set
characters.errata:
Stamina Changed 6/8 to 7/8. Physical and Energy Defense increased to 4 from 3. Shrapnel Blast replaced with Magnetic Crush. Fatal Attraction updated to 2 Power Cost. Force Projection replaced with Polarity Shield.

Q: If two players in a game are both playing Magneto, can one Magneto benefit from the other Magneto’s Metallic Constructs?
A: No, each Magneto puts their own Metallic Constructs into play. Their rules reference and affect only their own Metallic Constructs.

characters.name: M.O.D.O.K.
characters.errata:
Stamina change 10/4 to 10/5.

Q: M.O.D.O.K. has targeted Black Widow with his Doomsday Chair attack. Captain America then used his superpower Bodyguard to change the target to himself. The Whirling Blades special rule says I can make another Doomsday Chair attack, but I cannot choose the Original Target for the second attack. Which character is the Original Target?
A: When rules state Original Target they are referring to the target of the previous attack - so in this case that would be Captain America. You could select Black Widow for the second Doomsday Chair attack.

text: Underfoot: After each attack is resolved, if it dealt {DMG}, this character Pushes the target character {S}.

text: Add 2 dice to this attack for each allied Sand Construct within {RNG} 2 of the target character.

superpowers.name: REABSORB
superpowers.text: Choose an allied Sand Construct within {RNG} 3 of this character. Place this character within {RNG} 1 of the chosen Sand Construct. Then the chosen Sand Construct is KO'd and this character removes 1 {DMG} from itself.

superpowers.name: CREATE SAND CONSTRUCT
superpowers.text:
You may have 2 Sand Constructs in your Squad instead of the normal 1. You must activate all allied Sand Constructs before this character's Activation.
At the start of this character's Activation, if there are fewer than 2 Sand Constructs in play, this character may suffer 2 {DMG}. If it does, place 1 Sand Construct into play within {RNG} 2 of this character. It gains an Activated token and is part of your Squad.

superpowers.name: SAND MANIPULATION
superpowers.text: This character gains 1 {PWR} whenever an allied Sand Construct deals {DMG} or suffers {DMG} from an enemy effect.

superpowers.name: HEALING FACTOR [1]
superpowers.text: At the end of each of this character’s activations it may remove [1] damage from itself.

superpowers.name: WALL CRAWLER
superpowers.text: When placing the movement tool during an advance, this character counts as Size 5.
